structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Modes of Transportation: Highways, Bridges, Ferries, Rail, and Public Transportation

law.catch_line: Character of signs, markings, and signals
law.text: On any urban highway upon which the Board has expended funds, the location, form, and character of informational, regulatory, and warning signs, curb and pavement, or other markings and traffic signals installed or placed by any public authority shall be subject to the approval of the Commissioner of Highways.
